question:
The attached file lists the locomotives owned by a local railroad museum. It gives each locomotive’s identifying number, operating status, and the name of the daily excursion it heads, if operational. What are the odds that today’s Sunset Picnic Trip will use a steam locomotive? Assume that each day’s excursion picks one of its assigned locomotives at random, and express the answer in the form “1 in 4”, “1 in 5”, etc.

import pandas as pd
file_path = "/Data2-v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/4d0aa727-86b1-406b-9b33-f870dd14a4a5.xlsx"  # reuse loaded df if present

sunset = df[df['Excursion/Location'].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Sunset Picnic Trip']
steam_patterns = r"0-4-0|2-6-0|4-4-0|2-8-0|2-8-2|4-6-2|2-6-2|2-10-0|2-10-2|steam"
steam_like = sunset['Type/Wheel Configuration'].astype(str).str.contains(steam_patterns, case=False, regex=True)

print("Subset for Sunset Picnic Trip:\n", sunset[['Number','Type/Wheel Configuration','Operating Status','Excursion/Location']])
print("Total assigned (any status):", len(sunset))
print("Steam-like count:", int(steam_like.sum()))
odds = f"1 in {len(sunset)}" if int(steam_like.sum()) == 1 else (f"{int(steam_like.sum())} in {len(sunset)}" if int(steam_like.sum()) > 1 else "No steam")
print("Preliminary odds (based on assigned set):", odds)
